evals.prompt: We have read docs/operations/reliability_workstreams/p0_coordination_guide.md three times in this session, and now we need the escalation section again. Find it without dumping the whole guide into context.
evals.expected_output: A compact index with heading, line range, and locator rows plus a stored fingerprint, followed by retrieval from the escalation section's line anchor.
expectations: The source is indexed once with one row per heading and a fingerprint block.
The lookup opens only the located line range rather than the whole document.
The index contains no copied source excerpts or section summaries.

evals.prompt: A long reference guide was consulted earlier in this task. Before opening it again, follow the reference-index procedure so we can go straight to the relevant section.
evals.expected_output: The stored fingerprint is recomputed and compared before the index is used, and the lookup returns a source anchor.
expectations: The freshness check compares the stored fingerprint with the current path, size, modification time, and SHA-256 hash.
A matching fingerprint leads to an index lookup instead of a full read.
A mismatch triggers re-indexing before any answer relies on the table.

evals.prompt: The indexed guide was edited and its stored hash no longer matches. Repair the index and then use it to locate the deployment section.
evals.expected_output: The changed sections and shifted line ranges are re-indexed, a new fingerprint is stored, and the deployment section is located from the repaired table.
expectations: The mismatch is detected by the fingerprint comparison before lookup.
Affected headings and shifted line ranges are updated, with a new check timestamp.
The updated index is consulted only after the fingerprint is rewritten.

evals.prompt: Read this two-paragraph README at ./README.md once and summarize what it says.
evals.expected_output: The README is read directly; no navigational index or fingerprint is created.
expectations: No reference-index file or fingerprint is produced for the one-off read.
The document is summarized from its actual text rather than from an index.

evals.prompt: Quote the full license text from LICENSE exactly, from beginning to end.
evals.expected_output: The license is read and quoted verbatim; no index is used as a substitute for the source.
expectations: The source text is quoted directly, not located through an index.
No excerpt is copied into an index file.
